summary: Completed public sign-in, authenticated navigation, core dialogs, queue controls, tracker/Gmail rendering, and settings save testing.

critical.issue: SettingsIn.AutopilotIn does not declare paused, so saving Settings cannot clear the emergency-stop state. The UI remains paused after toggling Emergency paused off and saving.

minor.issue: Settings page rendered blank AI model, tone, and signed-in email values during authenticated UI verification despite the controls being present. Response/UI mapping should be checked.
Backend log recorded a duplicate-key 500 while concurrently initializing the same Clerk user; later requests succeeded. User creation should be idempotent under concurrent requests.

integration_issues.issue: The Settings switch appears to toggle, but the saved state remains paused because the backend drops paused from the update schema.

issues: AI model and email tone select controls appeared visually blank; signed-in email displayed as an em dash. Verify data loading/rendering and contrast.

action_items: Allow paused in the autopilot/settings update model or provide a supported unpause API path, then retest emergency stop and reset.
Investigate why settings model, tone, and user email render blank after authenticated GET /api/settings.
Make Clerk user initialization handle concurrent duplicate inserts without returning 500.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsIn.AutopilotIn and routes_applications.AutopilotIn omit paused even though the UI and emergency-stop behavior depend on persisting and clearing it.
AppShell renders two emergency-stop buttons with the same data-testid on desktop queue screens; tests and assistive targeting should use unique scoped IDs or a shared single control.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Existing pilot-tester data was used; temporary role/contact dialogs were opened without saving.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sign-in ticket flow works and all sidebar routes loaded. Contacts/opportunity dialogs, tracker export control, queue mode options, emergency stop, settings save, and Gmail status/redirect UI were exercised. Emergency pause remains active from testing because no supported API/UI path can clear paused; reset it before further autopilot testing.
rca of the issue: Emergency stop writes app_settings.autopilot.paused=true. The Settings UI submits the complete autopilot object, but routes_settings.AutopilotIn has no paused field, and Pydantic ignores the unknown key. The PUT therefore persists all other fields while retaining paused=true. The same omission exists in routes_applications.AutopilotIn, so the normal autopilot PUT path cannot clear it either.
